qualification: No PASS is inferred from training, smoke, or adapter execution.

cost_audit.scope: Known compute lower bound includes body/cleanup receipts, launcher processes and host once. Launcher GetProcessTimes does not include its Python child. Full child startup/teardown CPU and peak memory remain unmeasured; no complete-accounting claim.
cost_audit.upper_bound_assumptions: Four sequential owned workers; inner wall intervals are disjoint subsets of complete host wall; at most the recorded 32 logical CPUs can execute during the residual gap. Host/launcher measured CPU retained, making the bound conservative.

recomputed_quality.scope: Disposable training-set pipeline smoke only; no independent improvement, lineage or deployment authority.

admission.scope: Post-freeze host schema bridge only; independently replays unchanged raw evidence. No model execution or new learning claim.

gate.scope: Disposable smoke; every worker is a fresh process. A pass is required before the host may separately authorize main training. No development, selection or hidden roster is read.

smoke.raw_resource_warning: The original venv-launcher CPU/RSS aggregation excludes model descendants. Its complete-accounting flag is invalid and is not used in report totals. Original evidence is preserved.
smoke.scope: Disposable training-set pipeline test; not independent neural improvement.
